context.transcript:
Hi Susan, this is Thomas from the New York office.
The company leadership just received the headphone prototype your team developed.
They're very impressed with the audio quality, but some of them felt the padding was uncomfortable.
They want your team to use softer cushioning around the ears.
If you'd like a different materials supplier to correct the problem, I can send you the contact info for custom fibre.
They worked with us on last year's products.
Please call me back so we can talk about this more.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨苏珊，我是来自纽约办事处的托马斯。
公司领导层刚刚收到了你们团队开发的耳机原型。
他们对音质印象深刻，但有些人觉得耳垫不舒服。
他们希望你们团队使用更柔软的耳部衬垫。
如果你想找不同的材料供应商来解决这个问题，我可以给你定制纤维的联系信息。
他们去年也和我们合作过产品。
请给我回电话，这样我们可以更多地讨论一下这件事。
